text: An endangered animal could disappear forever. Only a few are left. Fewer than 200 pygmy raccoons are alive.
To struggle is to try hard at something that is not easy. The sister raccoon struggled to make a ball.
Intelligent means smart and good at learning. The raccoons showed they are very smart.
Cozumel is an island in Mexico. It is the only place where pygmy raccoons live.
Mexico is a country just south of the United States.
Pygmy raccoons are very small raccoons. They live only on one island.
A scientist studies the world to learn how things work.
A creature is any living animal.
To shock someone is to surprise them a lot. The scientists did not expect toy balls.
To weigh is to be heavy by a certain amount. A scale tells you how much.
A pound is a way to measure how heavy something is.
A kilogram is another way to measure weight. It is a little more than two pounds.
Mangroves are trees that grow in salty water by the sea. Their roots stick up out of the water.
The coast is the land right next to the sea.
To hunt is to look for animals to eat.
A snail is a small animal with a hard shell on its back. It moves very slowly.
A tourist is a person who visits a place on a trip. Tourists go to see new places.
Scraps are small bits left over, like food nobody finished.
A trash can is a bin where people throw things away. Garbage can means the same.
Tortilla chips are crunchy, salty snacks made from corn.
Nessie O’Neil is the scientist who watched the raccoons.
A receipt is a small piece of paper you get when you buy something.
To bat something is to tap it so it moves, like when a cat pats a toy.
The sister is the first raccoon’s sibling. They are both young.
To take over is to start doing a job that someone else was doing.
A coati is an animal like a raccoon with a long nose and a long tail.
A tool is something an animal or person uses to do a job. A stick can be a tool.
Behavior is the way an animal acts and what it does.
In science, culture means animals learn new ways of doing things from each other.
Born with a skill means you already know it from the start, without being taught.
Passed down means taught from one group to the next, like from parents to babies.
